newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Bank survey sees Swiss share prices headed lower.
newsitem.headline: Bank survey sees Swiss share prices headed lower.

text.p: A financial newspaper's survey of eight Swiss banks showed they expect the all-share Swiss Performance Index to drop on average 1.6 percent over 12 months.

The survey by Finanz und Wirtschaft, released ahead of publication on Wednesday, showed the average 12-month SPI target falling to 2,819 points from yesterday's close at 2,866.19. It was the first drop since the monthly poll began three years ago.
Five banks -- Julius Baer, SBC, CSFB, Zurich Cantonal Bank and Lombard Odier -- were cautiously optimistic, forecasting the SPI would stand between 2,880 and 2,960 in February 1998.
Societe Generale was the most bearish, putting the index at 2,400 points. Pictet and UBS also saw declines, it said.
